title: Senkutsu Katsuryu Taisen: Chaos Seed
native_title: 仙窟活龍大戦 カオス・シード
overview: Delve into the depths of vast underground labyrinths, seeking aid from the spirit world in bringing life back to a dying planet! Chaos Seed is a role-playing game with elements of action and strategy blended in. Players will have to make smart use of their resources and use feng shui to their advantage to proceed.
